The '''Unifras''' was a religious sect native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

Throughout centuries, as the wildlife declined, the Unifras religion erected a series of holy [[Temple|shrines]] on the cleared plains outside the walls of the [[City/Legends|city]], [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. These temples were built in an attempt to attract offworld visitors.
